title: Hollowed-Out Squid Dongbei Salt-and-Pepper Squid
description: Dongbei-style salt-and-pepper squid with a twist, featuring a crunchy hail topping and tender rest meat.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the hollowed-out squid and cook until browned on both sides, about 4 minutes.
Transfer the squid to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and add the sliced scallions.
Cook until the scallions are slightly caramelized, about 2 minutes.
Add the chili flakes, kosher salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
Return the squid to the skillet and stir to combine with the scallion mixture.
Transfer the squid to a serving vessel, such as a tagliere.
Sprinkle the hail salt over the squid and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Place the serving vessel under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the vessel from the oven and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Garnish with a side of sliced scallions, if desired.
